description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: mm/damon/ops-common: handle extreme intervals in damon_hot_score() (CVE-2026-64458)
  * kernel: net/smc: fix UAF in smc_cdc_rx_handler() by pinning the socket (CVE-2026-64541)
  * kernel: Bluetooth: hci_core: Fix UAF in hci_unregister_dev() (CVE-2026-74302)
  * kernel: platform/x86/amd/pmc: Fix LPS0 and debugfs leaks when STB init fails (CVE-2026-81015)
  * kernel: kernel: Memory corruption via out-of-bounds write in Ceph client (CVE-2026-89653)
  * kernel: uio: Fix stale info pointer in failed registration path (CVE-2026-93054)
  * kernel: Bluetooth: L2CAP: fix chan mode for LE_CONN_REQ + EXT_FLOWCTL pchan (CVE-2026-98108)
  * kernel: mm/hugetlb: preserve mremap address delta when skipping page tables (CVE-2026-98373)
  * kernel: net: openvswitch: conntrack: fix helper UAF due to extensions realloc (CVE-2026-98490)
  * kernel: kernel: Memory corruption via integer overflow in GUP-fast (CVE-2026-99661)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * cifs: periodic IO errors after rename, even after RHEL-192999 [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-307290)
  * CIFS: backport important fixes to AlmaLinux 9.9.z (JIRA:RHEL-309176)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
